title: Cooking with Agents in VS Code — Liam Hampton, Microsoft
talk_summary: Liam Hampton demos VS Code/Copilot agents across local, background, and cloud modes, using git worktrees, autopilot, custom agents/skills, and MCP. The transferable ideas are task-tiered oversight, isolated parallel workspaces, pre-PR checkpoints, and restricted CI sandboxes rather than any specific Copilot feature.

takeaways.technique: Tier agents by oversight and isolation
takeaways.what_they_do: Use local agents for hands-on test work, background agents in worktrees for larger UI tasks, and cloud agents for low-attention documentation.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I'd use a local agent when it comes to writing tests.

takeaways.what_they_do: Background agents run in an isolated folder mapped to its own branch, so parallel work does not share one checkout.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it is a branch that is mapped to an isolated folder within the workspace that you're working in

takeaways.technique: Pause before PR for local verification
takeaways.what_they_do: Autopilot is instructed to stop before creating a pull request and tell the developer how to test locally.
takeaways.evidence_quote: before you create a pull request because on Autopilot it will do a pull request, stop and pause and let me test locally

takeaways.what_they_do: Custom agents and skills encode narrow procedures such as writing tests, addressing PR comments, or creating PRs.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you're able to use very specific agents to tackle certain problems

takeaways.what_they_do: Cloud agents get Playwright MCP access to take screenshots and run automated front-end testing.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Playwright MCP server, so you can do testing with screenshots. You can do automated front-end testing.

takeaways.technique: Restricted CI sandbox for remote agents
takeaways.what_they_do: Cloud agents run in isolated GitHub Actions with network firewalls, allowlists, and no direct main-branch access.
takeaways.evidence_quote: network firewalls. You don't want this agent talking to a whole bunch of different things. It's absolutely white-listed and restricted.
